how.title: How it works
how.step1Desc: Install the app and connect your phone's idle compute. Setup takes about 90 seconds.
how.step2Desc: Your device picks up inference jobs — image, language, speech — in the background. Nothing extra to do.
how.step3Desc: Every completed task settles to your in-app balance.

devices.title: One network, every scale
devices.subtitle: Start with the phone in your pocket. Scale with dedicated, datacenter-hosted hardware.

tagline.phone: The zero-cost entry — the device you already own.

trust.title: Verify us yourself
trust.subtitle: Don't take our word for it. Company registration and compliance records are public — here's how to check them.
trust.pendingNote: Entity verification details are being finalized for publication.
trust.pocBody1: Every completed task generates an inference receipt — what ran, when, and what it earned. Receipts are recorded on the platform ledger with on-chain attestation.
trust.pocBody2: Your app shows the full receipt trail for every payout, so earnings are traceable end to end.

nex.pageTitle: NEX — the token that powers NexGrid's compute economy.
nex.pageLead: A plain-language guide: what NEX is, how it's created, and what you can do with it.
nex.src1Desc: Each completed inference task mints NEX straight into your holdings.
nex.src2Desc: Part of network commissions is denominated in NEX.
nex.src4Desc: Daily check-in faucet plus a welcome bonus for new accounts.
nex.usesTitle: Five things you can do with NEX
nex.use1Desc: Exchange NEX for USDT inside the app wallet.
nex.use2Desc: Burn NEX to cover withdrawal network confirmation fees.
nex.use3Desc: Use NEX toward device purchases and renewals.
nex.use4Desc: Lock NEX to earn staking interest.
nex.use5Desc: Keep NEX as part of your position in the network.
nex.mech1Desc: AI clients pay for compute; a share of platform revenue funds periodic buybacks.
nex.mech2Desc: 30% of platform fees are permanently burned, reducing supply over time.
nex.faq1A: No. USDT is the stable settlement asset; NEX is a utility token whose price varies.
nex.faq2Q: How do I turn NEX into USDT?
nex.faq2A: Inside the app wallet — convert NEX to USDT, then withdraw USDT.
nex.faq3Q: What determines the price of NEX?
nex.faq3A: Supply and demand: inference-driven minting, buybacks, and the burn mechanism shape supply; platform usage shapes demand. Prices can go down as well as up.
nex.faq4Q: How is NEX different from a memecoin?
nex.faq4A: NEX is minted only when real AI work completes and has defined in-platform utility — it is not a speculative meme asset.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: A distributed AI compute network. Idle phones and dedicated devices run AI inference tasks, and their owners get paid for the work completed.
faq.a2: Install the app, connect your phone's idle compute, and tasks run automatically. You can scale up later with dedicated devices. Real-time earnings show inside the app.
faq.q3: Do I have to spend money to start?
faq.a3: No. The phone tier is free — no hardware, no deposit. Paid devices are optional and add compute capacity.
faq.q4: How do I know the earnings are real?
faq.a4: Every completed task generates a Proof-of-Compute receipt recorded on the platform ledger with on-chain attestation. Your app shows the full receipt trail for every payout.
faq.a5: Dedicated devices run in professional datacenters — no shipping, no home setup. Your device activates shortly after purchase and appears in your app.
faq.a6: Earnings settle in USDT inside the app, and you withdraw USDT to your own wallet. The app walks you through it step by step.

final.title: Put your idle compute to work.
